Starter templates (create one with template action:"create", name, directory):
- coming-soon: Coming soon. A calm coming-soon page with a launch date, a one-line pitch and an email link for people who want to hear more.
- docs: Documentation. A two-page documentation site with a sidebar, an introduction with install and quick start, and a guide with configuration, options and troubleshooting.
- landing: Landing page. A product or project landing page in ink and signal lime: a big type-led headline, three numbered benefits, a how-it-works strip, an FAQ and a closing call to action.
- links: Link in bio. A single-column link-in-bio page in forest and cream: your initials, name and short bio, a highlighted latest link, four more links, your profiles and email.
- portfolio: Portfolio. A calm, editorial portfolio: your name up front, four project cards, a short about section and a contact call to action.
- resume: Résumé / CV. A clean one-page résumé with experience, education, skills and languages. Prints neatly to paper or PDF.
